name.zh-cn: 已保存的传输任务定义
用户在 Agent 页面手动决定、Transfer 持有的一次性运行审批
name.en: One-shot Transfer owner approval manually decided in Agent

name.zh-cn: 一次实际执行及其真实身份
name.en: An actual execution and its real identity

name.zh-cn: 停止态、无调度、无自动扫描的 bounded/snapshot/native table，显式 replace 或 append，不含特殊角色保护方式
name.en: Stopped unscheduled bounded/snapshot/native table without automatic scanning or special role choices; explicit replace or append

name.zh-cn: 首次只申请运行审批；用户手动批准后，原 AgentRun 按原任务配置和指纹消费一次；不明结果不重试
name.en: Initially request approval only; after explicit User approval, the original AgentRun consumes it once for the unchanged task and fingerprint; no uncertain-write retry

name.zh-cn: Owner 与现有执行体系核验当前身份、实际源读目标写及安全条件；审批和本体不授予权限
name.en: Owner and existing execution runtime check current identity, source read, target write and protection; approval and ontology grant no permissions

name.zh-cn: 按原 execution_id 读取状态、计数及受限诊断，受理不等于成功
name.en: Read state, counts and bounded diagnostics by original execution_id; admission is not success
